name: @useyolo/source-folder
description: Official Yolo source plugin: movies and shows from folders on the node's machine, a disk or a mounted NAS share

summary.en: Movies and shows from folders on your home machine, a disk or a NAS share.
summary.zh: 把家里电脑上的文件夹（硬盘或 NAS 共享目录）里的电影和剧集放到每块屏幕的首页。

summary.en: Movies and shows from folders on this machine
summary.zh: 这台电脑上文件夹里的电影和剧集

help.en: Absolute paths, separated by : (; on Windows)
help.zh: 绝对路径，用 :（Windows 用 ;）分隔

privacy.en: Reads only the folders you name, on this machine. Keeps nothing but caches.
privacy.zh: 只读取你指定的、这台电脑上的文件夹。除缓存外不保存任何东西。
